chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:

I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees blood while she is pregnant, as she used to before that in every month: should she leave the salat (prayer)? He said: “She leaves it if it continues.”

key_terms.الدَّمَ: blood seen by the woman during pregnancy
key_terms.تَتْرُكُ: she leaves or refrains from performing

ai.seo_question: Should a pregnant woman leave salat (prayer) if she sees blood during pregnancy?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who sees blood during pregnancy in a recurring pattern similar to her previous monthly bleeding. Imam Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام states that she leaves the salat (prayer) if the bleeding continues, indicating a jurisprudential basis for determining the ruling of such blood.
